hypothesis: Original save and offline source adapters may traverse project/Assets when it is a symlink to outside source, then write original C# outside the intended Unity project despite leaf.is_symlink false.
expected_signal: A root Assets symlink to a sibling external source tree must fail before any source or meta read/write; regular Assets tree must continue adapt and preserve .rgd data/meta.
negative_controls: Assets root symlink to outside Assembly-CSharp/SaveAndLoad.cs
Assets root symlink for synthetic Settings game source
normal Assets game source adaptation tests
limits: Source-stage filesystem safety, NOT game .rgd integration
Not a global TOCTOU-proof, no Unity/device runtime proof
